title: Ukraine Update — Nov 21, 2026

title: Ukraine Update — Nov 19, 2026
summary: Russia launched 98 drones plus Onyx anti-ship missiles overnight, followed by an hours-long drone raid on Kyiv. One person was killed and five injured; the Dutch and Austrian embassies and St. Volodymyr's Cathedral were damaged. Ukraine's strikes on the Kerch Bridge earlier in the week continue to drive fuel shortages in occupied Crimea. No verified reporting was found for Nov 14-16.

title: Ukraine Update — Nov 18, 2026
summary: A Ukrainian attack on Nov 17 caused part of the Kerch Bridge to collapse, with two reported killed. On Nov 18 Russia launched 141 long-range drones, 73 of them jet-powered, and Russian attacks killed at least five people nationwide, four in Odesa where the historic centre was hit. Energy facilities in Kyiv, Mykolaiv and Rivne oblasts were damaged. No verified reporting was found for Nov 14-16.

title: Ukraine History Tracker Update — Tue Nov 17, 2026
summary: A Ukrainian attack overnight on Nov 17 caused extensive damage to the Kerch (Crimean) Bridge, the road-and-rail link between Russia and annexed Crimea.

title: Ukraine Update — Nov 16, 2026
summary: Filed Nov 12-13 events. Witkoff and Kushner met Putin, who proposed a Kostiantynivka humanitarian mission, and a new round of talks was agreed without dates. Zelensky met the envoys near Dublin and was told the coming prisoner exchange would be the largest of the war. EU leaders met in Dublin over who speaks for Europe, and the Kremlin played down a European role. No verified reporting was found for Nov 14-16.

title: Ukraine Update — Nov 15, 2026
summary: The Nov 10-11 Abu Dhabi talks ended with an agreement in principle to exchange 314 prisoners of war but no breakthrough on ceasefire terms, territory or security guarantees. Witkoff and Kushner were due to meet Putin in Moscow, then Zelensky in Dublin. No verified reporting was found for Nov 12-15, so those days remain unfilled.

The second day of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi opened Nov 11 after Zelensky called day one constructive; no outcome was found.
